purpose: Teach: 代物/承っ/施さ/組み立てる/忘れ物/目指せ/習う/参観

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 時代の代物、見抜く目、若い頃から養った。
lines.en: I developed the ability to read what an era values—that's something I cultivated from my younger days.
lines.style: Measured, almost wandering. Unhurried pace. Slight pause between clauses, like remembering. Quiet authority without effort. The voice of someone who has earned the right not to rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。注文、丁寧に承っています。
lines.en: Yes. I take every order with care.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Direct eye contact. Formal register but not stiff—respectful without distance. A promise kept short and clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 手厚いケアを施さない取引先、関係、続かない。
lines.en: Business relationships that don't have genuine care behind them—they don't survive.
lines.style: Slow, declarative. Weight on each phrase. Not a lecture, but an observation earned. Slight emphasis on 'genuine'—the thing that matters most. Trailing thought, like he's seen it happen too many times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトを組み立てる若手、伸びてきました。
lines.en: The younger staff who know how to build projects well—they're starting to shine.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the tone. Noticing something real. Even pace, warm undertone. Pride without showing off. The voice of someone watching growth he helped make possible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 重要案件、忘れ物、絶対に避けろ。
lines.en: On critical projects—never let carelessness slip through. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Clean attack on 'critical.' The voice tightens slightly, becomes more deliberate. Not harsh—protective. A boundary being quietly set.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。目指せる目標、明確にしています。
lines.en: Yes. I make sure our goals are always clear and worth reaching for.
lines.style: Steady commitment. Direct address. No hesitation in the delivery. Formal but warm underneath—someone pledging to hold the standard. Voice stays even and sure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人から習う姿勢、リーダーにも必要だ。
lines.en: A leader who stays willing to learn from the people around them—that's what matters most.
lines.style: Closing observation. Slow, gentle delivery. The voice settles into this like wisdom being passed quietly across a table. Not grand—intimate. A principle held lightly but deeply.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。後輩の参観も、毎月企画します。
lines.en: Yes. We have junior staff sit in on meetings every month—that's how they grow.
lines.style: Warm, practical. The voice of someone putting principle into action. Steady rhythm. Small smile in the tone—he's thought this through and it works. Slight softening on the closing, like he's proud of the system he's built.
